newsitem.title: UK: UK shares advance after Dow rally, strong gilts.
newsitem.headline: UK shares advance after Dow rally, strong gilts.

text.p: UK stocks rebounded from Monday's losses at the start of trading on Monday, buoyed by yesterday's late rally on Wall Street and boosted by continued strength in gilts.

The FTSE 100 index was up 12.5 points at 4,051.0 by 0855 GMT, led by bank stocks amid hopes Abbey National's mortgage rate rise will feed through to higher profits. Gainers led decliners by some six-to-one.
Today's gain lifted the FTSE back towards its intraday record of 4,094.4 set November 26, with some traders saying the market is still poised for its traditional year-end rally.
